newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept motorcycle output up 3.8 pct year/year.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept motorcycle output up 3.8 pct year/year.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle production in September rose 3.8 percent from a year earlier to 232,203 units, increasing year-on-year for the third month, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA) said on Wednesday.

Domestic motorcycle sales in September rose 13.7 percent from a year earlier to 147,044.
JAMA said it expected Japanese motorcycle exports in September to have fallen about eight percent from a year earlier.

Domestic motorcycle production fell 3.3 percent from a year earlier to 1.34 million units in the April-September half-year, while domestic sales rose 1.3 percent to 666,561. Exports were expected to have risen about three percent.
